goal: Allow querying historical transactions and spenders by address or script without third-party indexers
External wallets and Electrum servers can track script activity directly from a pruned or full node
reviewability: Ready to review; conflicts with master are mechanical
agreement: Unaddressed objection: incorrect spentness on duplicate coinbase txids, no author reply (jaromil)
Open concern: holding mempool lock while scanning outputs could cause lock contention (jaromil)
Verified by testing reorg paging, lookups, and prefix collisions on mainnet (kravens, ViniciusCestarii)
Broad concept support to replace third-party indexers on low-resource nodes (arejula27, sedited, vasild)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because it adds a compact 54 GB index to replace separate, resource-intensive indexing software
Addresses a long-standing core capability request dating back to 2013 across multiple PRs

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it exposes address and script queries directly to external wallets and explorers
Unblocks downstream services without requiring full wallet descriptor imports
